words.example: A guardian has to sign when the patient is under eighteen.
words.exampleZh: 患者未满十八岁时，必须由监护人签字。

words.example: An interpreter will join the consent talk at three o'clock.
words.exampleZh: 三点会有一位口译员参加知情同意的谈话。

words.example: Call the language line when no interpreter is free on site.
words.exampleZh: 现场没有空闲的口译员时，请打翻译专线。

words.example: Give a plain explanation before you ask the family to sign anything.
words.exampleZh: 请家属在任何文件上签字之前，先做一遍通俗解释。

words.example: Use teach-back so you know the family understood the visiting rules.
words.exampleZh: 请用复述确认，看看家属是否真的听懂了探视规定。

words.example: The tools agent inside the HIS VM is two versions behind, so clean shutdown fails.
words.exampleZh: HIS 虚拟机里的虚拟化工具代理落后两个版本，正常关机因此失败。

words.example: Guest customization set the clinic hostname and joined the desktop to the domain.
words.exampleZh: 客户机定制写好了门诊主机名，并把这台桌面加入了域。

words.example: Run sysprep on the reference PC before you capture the clinic image.
words.exampleZh: 抓门诊镜像之前，先在参考电脑上做系统封装。

words.example: SID duplication on the cloned PCs made domain join fail for the whole clinic row.
words.exampleZh: 克隆电脑的安全标识重复，整排门诊机器加域都失败了。

words.example: An IP conflict appeared when two label printers came up with the same address.
words.exampleZh: 两台标签打印机带着同一个地址起来，地址冲突就出现了。
